name: CSV列の連絡先プロパティ対応行
prompt:
Recreate only the single HubSpot CSV mapping row shown in the primary original crop. Match its very wide, shallow 1738:93 aspect ratio (about 18.7:1). Do not add page context, neighboring rows, blank bands, or a card around the row. No Japanese mock exists; use the original crop as the geometry authority.

From left to right, preserve the same column positions and spacing: first, the CSV column name 「電話番号」 wrapped into two short lines, with sample value 「--」 on each of the two lines in the adjacent narrow sample column; next, a small pale-blue circular mapped-status icon with a white checkmark; next, an outlined dropdown with a person icon, label 「コンタクトのプロパティ」 and teal downward caret; next, a wider outlined dropdown labeled 「電話番号」 with teal downward caret; at the far right, an unchecked pale-gray checkbox with the low-contrast disabled label 「上書きしない」. Keep the checkbox visibly unchecked and disabled. Preserve the source’s compact 93 px row height, white background, thin cool-gray control outlines, teal carets, muted disabled color and wide horizontal gaps. Do not add icons or settings beyond those visible.
reviewNotes: LH09-0263 v001 compared with the assigned HubSpot mapping row. It preserves Phone Number, the two -- samples, mapped check, Contact properties and Phone Number selectors, and the disabled unchecked Don’t overwrite control. Major geometry defect: the generated image is 1715x917 (1.87:1) for a 1738x93 source (18.7:1), with large blank bands; controls are also compressed toward the center/left and oversized. Similar wide strips have repeatedly returned tall canvases, so one attempt was used. Status: needs-correction; image-generation review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
